trigger: User requested BGE Chinese plus all-MiniLM L6 English, running both for mixed queries. The frequency of mixed product traffic is a hypothesis, not measured evidence.

zh.queryPrefix: 为这个句子生成表示以用于检索相关文章：

en.minimumCosine: derive once using the rule below; no sweep

inputs.scope: Only fixed60 documents and248 train/calibration queries. No check scoring and no acceptance fixture access. Existing development is retrospective evidence, never independent qualification.
inputs.corpus: Encode all original eligible documents separately in both models; do not filter documents by language. Separate namespaces, fingerprints, dimensions, caches and per-model index coverage. Never compare or concatenate the embeddings.
inputs.newMixed: Existing248 data do not establish natural code-switch performance. A separate frozen development input set must precede its model collection; independent mixed quality remains pending.

englishThreshold.selection: Use only train positives group en-en and train pure-OOD queries with Latin but no Han in the routing signal. Rank each against the complete ID-eligible corpus using the L6 vectors. Require all train en-en raw top1 documents relevant. Set negativeMax to maximum eligible top1 cosine over the English OOD cohort and positiveMin to minimum top1 cosine over en-en positives. If negativeMax < positiveMin, use the midpoint rounded to two decimals only if still strictly above negativeMax and at or below positiveMin; otherwise use the exact midpoint. If no margin, record RED_NO_ENGLISH_MARGIN with no selected threshold and do not try another threshold/grid.
englishThreshold.validation: Apply the derived threshold unchanged to calibration and every comparison. Report English and Chinese OOD denominators separately and every direction. Never infer a full-language pass from the same-language aggregate.

routing.input: The original query is always encoded and searched unchanged. Only the temporary language signal is transformed; no raw source, authorization, structured-ID filter or citation is transformed.
routing.signal: On a temporary copy, remove fenced triple-backtick spans including an unterminated trailing span, inline backtick spans, http/https/www URLs, email addresses, slash/backslash path-like whitespace-delimited tokens, and ASCII alphanumeric identifier tokens containing a digit plus Latin or a separator. Do not strip ordinary natural-language Latin words. Preserve original case in all model inputs.
routing.buckets: Han means any Unicode Script=Han code point. English signal means a Latin-script word of at least two code points (Unicode Script=Latin). Han only => zh; Latin only => en; both => mixed; neither => unknown. A single remaining Latin word such as cache is enough for mixed. Complete IDs alone never imply English.
routing.unknown: No supported language signal means semantic unknown/partial, with existing source-authenticated strong lexical evidence preserved. Do not silently mark an unsupported query as a confident negative.
routing.order: Whenever both execute, process BGE then L6 sequentially, physical1, independently source-guarded. No concurrent model inference in this initial batch.

admissionAndFusion.perModel: Use global eligible K1 on the complete original coarse rank after all complete structured-ID eligibility; cut K before strong exemption and cosine admission, and never refill. Preserve source-authenticated same-field phrase/all effective terms/all complete IDs. Every weak lexical field chooses its fixed highest-coarse original96 UTF16/16-overlap window separately within each active model's complete eligible pool; use that model's same frozen cutoff, no sibling borrowing or alternate-window search after rejection.
admissionAndFusion.weak: A weak field passes if at least one active model independently passes its chosen window. Any required unknown branch makes overall coverage partial even when another branch supplies an admissible result; unknown is never a true negative.
admissionAndFusion.semanticFusion: Each active model contributes its passed semantic list in original within-model order. Deduplicate by source/field/revision/window identity and sum reciprocal ranks 1/(61+zeroBasedRank). Sort that sum descending, then first contributing model order BGE-before-L6, then original stable corpus ordinal. This makes one semantic list. Never use cross-model cosine to order or break ties.
admissionAndFusion.finalFusion: Fuse that single semantic list with the original lexical list using the existing90a 1/(61+zeroBasedRank) RRF and exact +1. Strong/weak lexical scores retain the existing lexical calculation. When a mixed-route semantic score is required for a final tie, use only its merged reciprocal-rank score, never a BGE/L6 cosine comparison. Stable source ordinal is the final tie-break. Single-model runs retain existing single-model tie behavior.
admissionAndFusion.scope: The existing fixed corpus has one field/window per source and <=1 lexical captured field per query; replay is limited to that corpus. Actual multi-window producer/metadata, ownership/credentials/PG, permission, abort/deadline and last-moment source freshness require separate live validation. No verifier process or probability bridge. automatic:null unchanged.

reporting.quality: For train and calibration separately: zh-zh, en-en, zh-en, en-zh, exact groups, ID mismatch, pure OOD by query language and route, missing-field/number diagnostics separately, coverage unknown/partial in all original denominators, branch calls and query/document encode counts. For dual OR admission, report total any-result FPR, not just per-model rates.
reporting.floors: Same-language Chinese and English Recall@5>=.90 and MRR>=.75, each language pure-OOD FPR<=.05, exact-ID preservation and complete coverage for development viability. Existing3.1 cross-language floors remain unchanged/pending; separate same-language viability from full release qualification.
reporting.resources: Raw BGE model/tokenizer24451175B + L6 model/tokenizer23745618B + shared text dependencies40533717B =88730510B, excluding existing Node/runtime, scripts/notices and final archive compression. Measure both native worker RSS/private in the same OS sample batch plus parent separately; never sum independent process peaks. Lazy loading/unloading, cold/index/warm-new/repeat and lifecycle are separate results. Two embedding indexes add storage/build work even when only one query branch executes.
reporting.decision: Root reviews deterministic router edge cases and independently recomputes scores/denominators before selecting a live candidate. Independent fresh quality,1000-fragment source/UI latency, all planned recovery/memory consumers, package/provenance and lifecycle remain required. No production/default/version/gate pass from this experiment.
